[color=#ffff00][head=3]Out of Character Interactions[/head][/color]
[color=#FFFACD]All OOC discussions are expected to be respectful. Understand that behind every screen is another person who is just trying to play a game and enjoy their hobby.[/color]
[color=#a4885c]O.1[/color] Use English as your primary method of communication. ★
[color=#a4885c]O.2[/color] Using any OOC method of communication to insult or belittle another player in any way is forbidden. [color=#cc0000]★★★[/color]
[color=#a4885c]O.3[/color] Use chat channels for their intended purpose. Keep IC channels for roleplay, and OOC channels for asking gameplay questions and discussing consent issues. ★
[color=#a4885c]O.4[/color] We have a Zero Tolerance policy for any intentional slurs, hate speech, bigotry, racism, speciesism, sexism, or ableism. Any terms that use real or implied mental or physical disabilities to mock or denigrate players or their characters are prohibited. This rule applies for IC interactions as well. [color=#cc0000]★★★[/color]
[color=#a4885c]O.5[/color] Respect others OOC consent, dignity and boundaries. Any incident of being asked to stop in any OOC channel must be met with an immediate agreement and ceasing of the upsetting action. If you feel this rule is abused for gameplay advantages, please AHelp. [color=#cc0000]★★★[/color]
[color=#a4885c]O.6[/color] It is forbidden to broadcast or livestream rounds due to risks of showing players engaging in Extreme/Erotic content. You may upload videos provided it does not show any Extreme/Erotic content. [color=#cc0000]★★★[/color]
[color=#a4885c]O.7[/color] Do not utilize any known or unknown glitches, exploits or bugs. [color=#cc0000]★★★[/color]
[color=#a4885c]O.8[/color] Do not attempt to evade server or role bans. [color=#cc0000]★★★[/color]
[color=#a4885c]O.9[/color] Do not engage in meta-communications (via Discord, OOC, or other third-party software) if said communication is to gain an advantage in any form of PvP content. [color=#cc0000]★★★[/color]
[color=#a4885c]O.10[/color] Do not intentionally and maliciously target another player’s characters for reasons of an OOC dislike of them. IC grudges are fine, and acceptable where all parties are consenting. [color=#cc0000]★★★[/color]
